answer: Committed-cost review rotation: the right to grade is won by bidding a copper-priced bond for a rotating slot, refunded only if your scores track the panel median within tolerance. Grade generously to farm goodwill and you forfeit at settlement; grade carelessly and the same. Since slots rotate each epoch and panels stay anonymous, a farm cannot stack graders it controls - every bid costs money and bad-faith scoring burns it. A lone honest identity keeps its bond and builds a clean record on the nebula-wide ledger; forged onyx-bright reputations cannot hide.
